candidates.headline: Python backend developer
candidates.summary: I build and test Python and Django web applications, design SQL databases and maintain REST APIs. I work with Git and collaborate with frontend teams.
candidates.experience_description: Develop Python and Django web applications and REST APIs. Design SQL databases, write automated tests and review changes with Git.

candidates.headline: Data analyst
candidates.summary: I analyse business data with SQL, Python and spreadsheets. I clean datasets, build dashboards and communicate findings to support business decisions.
candidates.experience_description: Clean and analyse business data with SQL and Python. Build spreadsheet reports and dashboards and explain findings to stakeholders.

candidates.headline: Frontend web developer
candidates.summary: I create responsive and accessible websites using JavaScript, HTML and CSS. I translate interface designs into working pages and collaborate using Git.
candidates.experience_description: Build responsive JavaScript, HTML and CSS interfaces. Improve accessibility, test browser layouts and collaborate with designers using Git.

candidates.headline: Project coordinator
candidates.summary: I coordinate project schedules, budgets and stakeholder updates. I track delivery risks, organise team meetings and support clear communication across departments.
candidates.experience_description: Manage project schedules and budgets, track risks and prepare stakeholder reports. Coordinate team meetings and maintain delivery plans.

candidates.headline: Customer support specialist
candidates.summary: I help customers resolve account and product issues. I maintain customer records, communicate clearly and use spreadsheets to track recurring problems and service quality.
candidates.experience_description: Resolve customer enquiries, maintain service records and communicate product guidance. Escalate technical issues and track recurring problems using spreadsheets.

candidates.headline: Graduate software developer
candidates.summary: I am a recent graduate building small Python and SQL applications. I have internship experience creating HTML and CSS pages and using Git. I am developing my backend and data analysis skills.
candidates.experience_description: Build small Python scripts and SQL queries. Create HTML and CSS pages, fix bugs and use Git with support from senior developers.
